question: Who was the first General Secretary of the Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AO Hume**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On December 28**, 1885, the **Indian National Congress **was **founded **in **Bombay **by **Scottish resident **"**Alan Octavian Hume**".
 
• The **first president **of the **Congress **was "**Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee**".
 
• The **youngest president **of the **Congress **was "**Abul Kalam Azad**", who presided over the **special session **of **Delhi in 1923**.
 
• The **1888 session **of the **Congress **was **presided **over by the **first Englishman "George Yule**".
 
• **"Motilal Nehru" **presided over the **1919 Amritsar session **of **Congress**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gopal Krishna Gokhale **was an **Indian **'moderate' **political leader **and a **social reformer **during the **Indian independence movement**. **Gokhale **was a **senior leader **of the **Indian National Congress **and the **founder **of the **Servants of India Society**.
 
• **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi **was an **Indian lawyer**, **anti-colonial nationalist**, and **political ethicist **who employed **nonviolent resistance **to lead the **successful campaign **for **India's independence **from **British rule **and to later **inspire movements **for **civil rights **and **freedom across **the **world**.
 
• **Womesh Chandra Bannerjee **was an **Indian barrister**. He was **the co-founder **and first **president **of the **Indian National Congress**. Born in **1844 in Calcutta**, he studied at the **Oriental Seminary **and the **Hindu School**.
